description: This source file defines interfaces related to stream queue load balancing in Orleans, including IStreamQueueBalancer and IStreamQueueBalanceListener, specifying methods for managing queue distribution and notifications.

classes.name: IStreamQueueBalancer
classes.description: Interface for load balancing queues across stream sources, with methods for initialization, shutdown, retrieving queues, and managing subscription to queue change events.

classes.name: IStreamQueueBalanceListener
classes.description: Interface for components that listen to queue distribution changes and handle notifications accordingly.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the stream queue balancer with a queue mapper.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the stream queue balancer.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Retrieves queues assigned to this balancer.

methods.name: SubscribeToQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to queue distribution change notifications.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from queue distribution change notifications.

methods.name: QueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles notification of queue distribution changes.
